d: Long, flowing rose-pink hair is styled into two high pigtails with blunt-cut bangs and tied with small red bows. The bright azure eyes have a wide, cheerful expression on a youthful, teenage face. The build is slender and petite, dressed in a black sailor-style school uniform with a red neckerchief, a short pleated black skirt, white knee-high socks, and black loafers. A white jacket with blue star patterns is worn draped off the shoulders, and several large, colorful stylized pencils and glowing gold stars float in the surrounding space.
